_schema.description: PR-Y1.1 chord-recognition eval set — 20 CC-licensed tracks for genre-balanced accuracy measurement against KlangioChordSource (and future providers). Metadata ONLY — audio is downloaded on demand by apps/worker/tests/test_chord_eval.py into .chord-eval-cache/ (gitignored) when CHORD_EVAL_FETCH=1 is set.
_schema.verification_protocol: Before CHORD_EVAL_FETCH=1 is ever flipped on, every row with verification_status != 'verified' MUST be manually reviewed against its FMA/Jamendo/YT Audio Library license page. The staging verification lead flips verification_status to 'verified' and commits the update in a follow-up PR. This file is intentionally seeded with verification_status='pending' because the PR author cannot fetch external URLs during the build and would not hallucinate specific track IDs under the CC3-strict guard.
_schema.verification_log: PR-Y1.eval-verify (2026-11-04) performed a first WebFetch-based verification pass: 4 verified, 1 replace_recommended, 15 pending. PR-Y1.eval-verify-2 (2026-11-05) performed a second pass covering the remaining 15 rows plus the replace_recommended row 5: track-level WebFetch verified Kevin MacLeod (Jazz Sampler / Classical Sampler / Calming), Josh Woodward (Breadcrumbs instrumentals), Jahzzar (Blinded by Dust), Lobo Loco (FREE FOR YOU - CC BY), and Jason Shaw (Audionautix: Acoustic). Rows pointing at unreachable hosts (Kai Engel, Audionautix root, Jamendo JS-only search, Dexter Britain CC collections which are all CC BY-NC-SA, Podington Bear FMA catalog which is CC BY-NC, .mil band sites) were REPLACED with WebFetch-confirmable tracks in the same genre slot. Companion report: chord_eval_songs.verification.json. Current state: 19 verified, 1 pending (row 17 wildcard-metal — no CC BY-SA metal track could be verified via WebFetch in this session; follow-up should either verify a specific Jahzzar Super track slug or replace with a verified heavy-rock track).
